notes.title: 2025.08.29 Update
notes.notes:
Hello!

Today’s maintenance is a short temporary maintenance.

However, there are a few changes we’d like to inform you about:



1. Language Addition

​

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11713497/be9328c8f9d492299d504fc39d55cab3ddd7cc7f.png"]

Indonesian, Spanish, Portuguese, German, and French have been added.

Translations may not be perfect. If you find strange parts, please let us know so we can fix them.

The translator function is not included in this update.

​

2. Crystal of Passion

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11713497/83f5298694e101336c67f12b3250af2770f5ace3.png"]

The Crystal of Passion has been changed to a non-tradable item!

This item was originally designed to be non-tradable, but it was mistakenly left out in the previous update.

Also, the number of Crystals of Passion obtainable during Fever Time has been increased.



3. Fishing “Empty Catch” Bug Fix

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11713497/e304e6047a7e0ef0035e5779109078ac41210d96.png"]

Freshwater crayfish, mandarin fish, lamprey, sturgeon, pufferfish, koi, eel, carp, etc.

We discovered that the values for the “cannot be caught” state were not set correctly, and have fixed this.

The chances of getting “nothing bites” have been reduced.

Thank you!

notes.title: Update 2025.08.22
notes.notes:
Hello!

We would like to inform you about today’s server maintenance and update!


Fever Time added!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11713497/39aa95f6d5356611fc9c745a2b2edd7c01012f61.gif"]

​

Fever Time is coming!

​

On servers where you can gather resources (excluding personal villages), Fever Time will occur when mining blocks!

Fever Time starts with a duration of approximately 12 seconds,

and during this time, the following effects are applied:

​

(1) Damage is doubled!

(2) Gain 1 extra block when mining!

(3) Special blocks appear that allow you to obtain additional Passion Crystals!

​



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11713497/4c27f42b81540a021462436582f2c039ce50911c.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11713497/6254fedb21e423adec0e472adac73de5b78109a9.png"]

The Passion Crystals obtained can be exchanged at the event vending machine for Constellation Commemorative Boxes!


New Start Point Options Added!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11713497/a58e95f8fe8fa99ec64e0643575ff9db19123445.png"]

At the start point, two new options have been added:



Return to the start point upon death.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11713497/be028c237aab1a43722d1c26993e9e82d1e3e615.gif"]

Currently, when you die, you return to a designated location (in personal villages, it’s the starting point).

If this option is enabled, you will return to the very first start point you stepped on!



Time continues even after death.

Currently, time ends when you die or return to the spawn area.

This new option allows time to keep running even after death!


UI Improvements!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11713497/d0388cc5e97a6a36b7f07f7d606c036ed9080591.png"]

A search function has been added to the crafting of Steam Heaters.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11713497/573cec7680062e4d3502016561154a63528aa2c7.png"]

In the item encyclopedia, items that can be dismantled now show a Dismantlable label.


Celestial Sphere Dye Bug Fixed!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11713497/cc37ed77080656bc5d9bd29d9704f00082531a0f.png"]

Previously, in personal villages, when replacing the “Moon” in the Celestial Sphere section,

the Moon’s color would be forcibly set to black.

This bug has been fixed.



Thank you!

notes.title: 07/28/2025 Update
notes.notes:
#. Chat Window Feature Update



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11713497/e80f88f08f3769ef3fd8e91de692325a3f471f11.png"]


A red notification alert has been added for new messages in Basic Chat, Party Chat, and Whispers!





#. Constellation Guidebooks Added

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11713497/d78e3712237ffd29b3aa92276767f60285308b61.png"]





You can now craft 12 constellation guidebooks using the Simple Paper Machine.


The inner pages (contents) of the constellation guidebooks can be crafted at the Ancient Library, located at the starting area of "The Land of Radiant Abundance."





[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11713497/2b656251d53d48e0bee5fbc4379e60dedbabdac0.png"]


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11713497/ec7c78c5235fe787a8e0cbcc419080beffd3f9de.png"]





Each book consists of 4 pages!


Constellations can be crafted from these guidebooks.






#. Constellation Enchanting


Constellations have different tiers depending on their type.


You must raise the tier in order to actually place the constellation.






[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11713497/dcd4ea8d93092c4315a2a079ad6b411fb607b17c.png"]


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11713497/a95033b7dec6c286e2d9c73131d758479b4acdf0.png"]





The following items are primarily required for enchanting:


​



1. Material: Star Crystal





[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11713497/65185344e20a285fe0672836313cc2ef67c008dc.png"]


Star Crystals can be crafted at the Alchemy Table using 10 “Mago Crystals” and 1 Bronze Ingot.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11713497/8a916ef4bda12813a770e301c63a0929526fd780.png"]


Mago Crystals can be obtained through the "Constellation Commemorative Box," which can be exchanged for up to 30 per day along with rocks in the Land of Radiant Abundance.


In the future, Mago Crystals will also be continuously obtainable through non-event content such as "Block Mining Content."


​



2. Samsara’s Protection Stone


​


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11713497/b000bcc9eb5ccbfa3b1461bca33cc71d8f948dd8.png"]


Enchanting can fail.


If it fails, the tier will decrease.


Samsara’s Protection Stone prevents this downgrade when failure occurs.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11713497/629251b9f1383c0b73beb6102ef552a18263fb38.png"]


Samsara’s Protection Stone can only be purchased in the Cash Shop with currency. You can buy around 100 for 1 Cash!





[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11713497/1ffcd0355171aefa0108b3a858d1a3043c9425c3.png"]


It activates when the success rate is not 100%.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11713497/2aea4dbc688d4830f13270725804528cec1dbbbc.png"]


It is used when enchantment fails, and currently it completely prevents tier downgrade at 100% probability.


However, the number of protection stones consumed per use varies by tier. (In the screenshot above, 7 stones are used per attempt.)


​



3. Lucky Stone / Mysterious Lucky Stone


​


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11713497/7f3b6177dc6c4814de6d31c414e99df188e5b02a.png"]


Lucky Stones / Mysterious Lucky Stones increase the success rate.





Lucky Stones can be crafted with 10 Unstable Lucky Stones and 10 Silver Ingots to make 10 Lucky Stones.


Unstable Lucky Stones can also be obtained from the "Constellation Commemorative Box."





Mysterious Lucky Stones can be crafted with Lucky Stones and 10 Gold Ingots.

notes.title: Update 2025-03-07
notes.notes:
Added
Book System
GM 흙먹어헌터's Counseling #1
The book system has been added. The first book, GM 흙먹어헌터's Counseling #1, can now be created and used. Various other books will be published in the future.

Materials

 GM 흙먹어헌터's Counseling #1
 Fortune Cookie Notes


How to Create GM 흙먹어헌터's Counseling #1

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11713497/9016518fbb29bbf931ae7599876377a9c67e115a.jpg

[olist]
 Craft GM 흙먹어헌터's Counseling #1 at the Simple Paper Machine
 Open GM 흙먹어헌터's Counseling #1 and insert Fortune Cookie Notes.
 Each page requires 10 specific Fortune Cookie Notes, which must be registered all at once.
 If even one note is missing, the registration will not proceed.
 Incomplete pages will display a pencil icon.
 Selecting this icon will show the required notes for that page.
 If all required notes are available, the Write button will become active.
 Pressing the Write button will register the page.
 Completed pages will display a book icon.
 Selecting this icon will show the page's content.
 The character who completed the last page will be credited as the publisher when the book is opened.
[/olist]

How to Use GM 흙먹어헌터's Counseling #1

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11713497/0cdd10b062c0a87fe3758cc3962e64e0f204b62e.jpg

[olist]
 Select the item from Inventory or Storage.
 Press the Read button in the tooltip.
 Choose a Counseling session.
 At least one page must be completed for counseling to be available.
 Follow the instructions to use the counseling feature.
[/olist]

Improved
Brick Mastery
The number of bricks that can be placed per level has been increased.
At level 60, the brick placement limit has increased from 237 to 355.
Personal Town
Town owners can now move furniture placed by other players.
Splitting Ingot-Type Items
When ingot-type items are stacked, selecting the stack will now display a Split button in the tooltip.
However, if the inventory is full, the Split button will not appear.
Faster Fortune Cookie Processing
The processing speed for checking Fortune Cookies has been increased.

notes.title: Update 2024-12-06
notes.notes:
Added
Imitation block slab
I
 mitation block slab has been added.
 Imitation block slab is a block slab that imitates the surface of surrounding blocks. However, it cannot be stacked twice in a single space.
 The Imitation block slab mimics blocks in the following order: the block below, the block above, and the block on the side.
 This block can be obtained through exchange at the event vending machine. The exchange period, required materials, and quantities may change frequently.


Vertical Movement Gate (Downward)
The Vertical Movement Gate (Downward), an electric object, has been added. The Vertical Movement Gate (Upward) moves objects upward, the Vertical Movement Gate (Downward) moves objects downward.

Plant Nutrient
A potion that increases the HP of plants being cultivated in the kitchen garden. However, the HP of plants that can be increased using this potion is limited to a maximum of 50%.  

Wolran's Time Blessing

 Wolran's Time Blessing is a potion that allows the crops in the kitchen garden to progress in time even when the user is not present in their town. However, if the crop’s HP falls below 10% while Wolran's Time Blessing is active, the passage of time in the kitchen garden will stop. Time will resume if user enters the town.
 It can be purchased from the coin shop.  


Improved
Kitchen garden
- When the HP of crops decreases, it will be visually displayed on the Kitchen garden.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11713497/8a57d9f03c3945765ab8c3de1f3fde756c91e9ac.jpg

- Sulfur fertilizer can now be applied to the Kitchen garden by dragging it in. When applied, the Kitchen garden’s pH will be adjusted to the maximum level suitable for the crops being cultivated.

Stack Limit Adjustment 
The stackable limit for farming items such as heat packs, ice packs, and sulfur fertilizer has been increased to 1,000.  

Translation
The translation feature has been improved.

notes.title: Update 2024-11-29
notes.notes:
Added
Wolran's Time Blessing

 These are items that allows time to flow for plants even when there are no users in the private town.
 If you use these items, time will flow for crops being grown in all gardens within your private town, even if there are no users in the private town.
 It will be applied when used in the inventory.
 You can purchase it later from the Coin Shop.


Illusory Weather

 These are items needed when artificially fixing the weather.
 If you use these item, you can select the desired weather at the effects tab of the town information window regardless of the number of times during the application time.
 If you select the weather, the weather will be applied to the private town, but the temperature change in the private town will be the same as before.
 If you use this item in the inventory and select the weather at the effects tab of the town information window, the weather will be applied.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11713497/06ff366bbf9e805b69ac68ce8790781e16876f9d.png

 You can purchase it from the Coin Shop.

notes.title: Update 2024-11-23
notes.notes:
Added
Improved Kitchen Garden

 Improved Kitchen Garden that allows dyeing has been added.
 The Improved Kitchen Garden can store more nutrients


Improved
Farming System

 There have been changes to the concept of the farming system.
 The changes apply to the three types of flowers that were added in last week’s update.


Changed Concept
The farming system’s difficulty has been lowered, but crop grades have been added
The grades are divided into Normal, Fine, and Prime.

The Fine grade has a larger quantity than the normal grade, and in the case of the Prime grade, when you plant the flower in a pot, an effect that adds brilliance is shown.

Flowers that have been successfully grown before will be applied to the Prime grade.

Crop grades are determined by the crop's HP at the end of the farming period.
This information can be checked through the Kitchen Garden’s UI.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11713497/2b4302595d5372876106cc7d79f4a4a04a2684a8.png

By lowering the difficulty, some internal attribute values of the crops, such as the maximum HP of the crops, have been changed.

"Deliver Chuseok apple to Grandfather Wolran!"
Event Period: 09/27 ~ 10/11

You must find Grandfather Wolran, who is somewhere deep in the forest, and deliver apples to him. 
However, because this forest is so constantly changing that you cannot tell where you are, and there are rumors that dangerous wild beasts are roaming around.
Will you be able to find Grandfather Wolran safely?

How to play
1. Enter the event map.

2. Go on an adventure to find Grandpa Wolran.

3. When you safely arrive at Grandpa Wolran, look for the ‘Special Event vending machine’ nearby.

4. You can exchange ‘Ripe apple’ for ‘Wolran's pocket money envelope’ at this ‘Special Event vending machine’.
This ‘Wolran's pocket money envelope’ will be sent to your mailbox immediately and can be received at the mail box in the main server.

5. You can collect ‘Wolran's pocket money envelope’ and exchange them for various items at the Event Vending Machine in the main server.

Caution
Delivery item ‘Ripe apple’
When you enter the event map, a ‘Ripe apple’, clothing items, and two Cube trackers are automatically added to your inventory.
If you want to play again after completing, please please exit the event map and re-enter.

Inventory
This event map uses a dedicated inventory that is only used on the event map.
It is not linked to the main server's inventory.
Therefore, you cannot take items from the main server and you cannot take items from the event map to the main server.
When you leave the event map, your event map inventory will be reset.

mini map
You cannot see the mini map here. You have to go around and find Grandpa Wolran.

treasure box
But don't worry! If you open the treasure box on the event map, you can obtain useful items (e.g. Cube tracker or magic broom) to find Grandpa Wolran.

beast
Be wary of the forest's beasts, including bears and wolves. If they spot you, you will be attacked.

Etc.
The event server periodically changes spawn location, terrain, and Wolran location.
Additionally, Coin Shop are not available in the event map.

You can report in-game user who maliciously interferes with gameplay or uses profanity and swearing.

notes.title: Update 2019-06-17
notes.notes:
Added
Title system
Title system has been added.
Now you can craft titles and apply titles to your characters.
Also, you can freely arrange 2 titles you have and give your character a unique title.

Existing personal title will be delivered to each owner as title item that can not be produced.
Users who have personal title will already be equipped when they start the game.


Carving Table
It is a production table that can make an Artisan's Title.
It can be made at the Carpentry table

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/437abc0c72b2f1c9b4e7a6cf6936e73f62950c6f.png

Artisan's Title
If you register these in title window, title will be applied.
It can be produced on the ‘Carving Table’ and can be deleted, and traded. Disassembly is not possible.
You can see a list of titles in the item book or Carving Table

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/1a57bf3c19735020ff1f5ca6b9fb42e1ca1bbd3a.png

[olist]
 Select the Title tab in the Character window. Or, if you click on the title item in the inventory, the title window will appear.

notes.title: Update 2019-05-22
notes.notes:
Added
Marriage
You can marry another player.
To be married, you must be a couple with the user who wants to marry.

Couple status
When a couple is connected to the same map, their position on the map is displayed as a heart.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/57de8e707fed601f1104568be23887710cde8e16.png

Also, when they get close to each other, their eyes turn into a heart.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/80eb5f4230a229881f338dcb53477b86ca23a1c5.png

Couples can get ‘Emoticon mastery’ experience when they are connected together.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/2f53af77f5b679740e7b21ab2b7a7caf4d97a098.png

How to be a couple

[olist]
 Double-click the [Romance Bouquet] in the inventory. And equip it.
 click on the user you want to be a couple.
    You can not confess if the person you want to confess is already a couple or married.
    You can not confess to a divorce penalty user or a blocked user by you or the user blocked you

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/b22daaa15f8d8680a10b8e75a3ffe1ce052dc217.png

 Press the [Love Confession] button to write the message you want, and then press the check button to confess.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/79d22280600661468cb2043029b5ce0d79ae14a7.png

 The confession message is displayed on the screen of the user who has received the confession, and accept or reject button appears.
 When he/she press the Accept button, the two user become a couple, and the bouquet is disappeared.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/526c16126245c095414de4d84df6303bfaf192c1.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/6e0505d4716ddce45d04f4edcfee32db95a854b4.png

 If he/she press the reject button, the two user do not become a couple, and the bouquet is disappeared. And a person who confess can not [confess] for five minutes.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/ff6db5408b44c9b2544670e8f363c47098e03f20.png

[/olist]

Married status
When you are married, you get the same effect as a couple. In addition, you can use the ability to move to the location of him/her.

Teleportation
If you press the ring button on the main screen, you can move to the position of your spouse.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/b43b371d7509401fca0c7ca458740c825655ec4b.png

However, it can only be used in the same map, and you can not use it while your spouse log out or Cooldown is activated.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/c4e7932130fee481bef096b9434038c973460afa.png

How to get married

[olist]
 One of the couples wear a [Propose Love Ring]. 
 Click the user you want to marry, then press the [Propose] button.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/e2d0d05a2ba81ed6ee0fdc889eb37f0ef8814d3a.png

 Write a proposal message in the window that appears, and then click the check button to send a message of proposal.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/c0a6718e294aa13f5c91b99c257e4dd93642a90d.png

 The proposal message, acceptance button and rejection button appear on the screen of the user who has been proposed.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/e07b8815a7cb03dec5d2382042cd09fe1b6796aa.png

 If the user who has been proposed press the Accept button, the two people will be married and the [Propose Love Ring] will be disappeared. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/32ecf99b56ed2b8aa90791ba26d90312d02ad3a1.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/7c0552004fd9319f56e148b4743159526063ac3d.png

 The ring does not disappear if the proposal is rejected.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/bd5680c023f16f14647f671cf63815d0f562547c.png
[/olist]

Break up
If there is a meeting, there is a separation. If you do not like your boy/girl friend or spouse, you can break the relationship.
Separation or divorce requires the consent of the other. If you want to leave without the consent of the other, you need a separation item.

How to break up with consent
[olist]
 Click on the user you want to break up with.
 Click the [Break up] button to tell the other that you want to break up.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/09736f52d7a11e3861236f74328a249402e427c7.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/a442104c183496813102c6428958f3d6410c290c.png

 If the other accepts, the relationship will be broken and the image in front of the nickname will be deleted.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/e1860561b14873d8f21389cecb3635b93fbaa833.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/620f22cbdbb5c59a6904932c465ca7255e4d8e37.png

Also, if you break your marital relationship with mutual consent, you will not be able to use teleportation, and you will not be able to make a new relationship with other people for 6 hours (game play time).

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/02ef070cda5ac7bef2acf4d9e49afc014db1a50a.png

How to break up without consent

[olist]
 When you want to finish the relationship without the consent of the other, separation item is required.
     In the case of a couple, it is possible to make it with a p key, and divorce items must be purchased at the coin shop. If you use this item to end your marital relationship, you can make a new relationship with someone without a time penalty.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/655f560d1ca87bd949f718832d85aaad3bd924fe.png

 If you have a separation item, double-click on the separation item in the inventory to break up.
 If you accept the separation message, you can end the relationship without the consent of the other.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/1bf7367866c10d63769888f1c3e3b6ecd59afb0b.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/7a31e6fd51a62c2f3791d6b4738c5f3110b1e259.png

    If you end your marriage, you can not have a new relationship with another person for 1 days.
[/olist]

Essential items related to marriage

It is an item used for confession, and can be made by pressing the P key.

The divorce scissors
This item is used to divorce without the consent of the other
You can buy it in coin or ledit at the coin shop.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/70add6fccdec3a8d9d9e74fcf6e49d03fd18c0ad.png

New Items

You can now feed your animal through [give to animal] interaction.

Animal feed
You can use raw meats, crops, weeds and flowers, leaves, and fruits to feed animals.
Food items that are cooked for humans can not be given to animals.

 Herbivores
    They can eat crops, weeds, leaves, and fruits except raw meat.
 Omnivore
    They can eat crops, weeds, leaves, fruits and raw meat except the omnivorous and carnivorous raw meat.
 Carnivores
    They can eat crops, weeds, leaves, fruits and raw meat except carnivorous raw meat..

Among the crops, pepper, onion, green onion, and garlic are foods that all animals dislike.

[olist]

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/2a898b6c1b229b5587b81d58d4cb6c8354000641.png

[/olist]

notes.title: Update 2018-04-20
notes.notes:
Added
Various masteries, functions and items have been added.

 1:1 trading system 
Finally, 1:1 trading system has been added.
You can now trade items safely and easily.
You can not trade if the user you want to trade with is away or blocked. If the distance from the trader becomes long, the transaction will be canceled.

 How to use 
1. Click the character you want to trade.

2. Click 'Apply Trade' to request a trade.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/ab0397278700bdfbeff9fa50eb7f950631bf3618.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/04442dd36f1ca9b9c57bc78769f14a9c8f33f5f4.png

3. When the other user accepts the trade, a trade window appears. You can open your inventory and put up to 5 items you want to trade.

4. When you have inserted the item you want, click the Lock List button and click the 'v' button to confirm the trade. At this time, you have to wait for the approval of the other trader.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/32c1787985f9f43ffa2d45f5d560487a746d4c82.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/d51b5a0f339b8a64830402bbbc1ecb4b7bb4a8f8.png

5. When the trader registers the item and presses the ‘v’ button, the trade is ended. When you cancel a trade or unlock a list, you and the other trader list are unlocked.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/db1eab806f27d93f2bd7d4c4412336a4f25c8757.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/808369e0c5dc2e3574b9f07721b4954afa6d9cf1.png

 Locating of ore, Locating of plant Mastery 
Now you can locate the plant and ore brick.
The number of markers and their hold time will be longer depending on the level of each mastery.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/279475b683ee1c4cd517e93cde4d66f43208cafe.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/63e12eeb8be51041782b7753d5eec540eb3c27de.png

 Required Item 
Cloudy Vaynell, Phoibos Vaynell

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/148975c0812f771fec7a1167f16e6bebb61471a5.png

To locate, each mastery requires a different item.
To find a plant brick, you need the 'Cloudy Vaynell' and to find an Ore Brick, you need the 'Phoibos Vaynell'. Because these items have mystical powers, they can be made from Mystery Altar.
Whenever you use these items, you gain mastery experience.
You can not move a character while using an item.
  
 How to use 
1. First of all, craft ' Cloudy Vaynell ' or ' Phoibos Vaynell ' from the Mystery Altar.

2. Insert then into the quick slot.

3. When items in quick slot selected, an activating button appears on the screen.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/b18d17b4ef15d78bd2afc925ed68bc1edc1cf861.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/9f0312d4c297a2fa94791e8f5cffb713225d011d.png

4. Press the button to display the location of the bricks. And then their location will be appeared.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/120986f79b2ad6e1204fc8ce31a2cd60c6bb5c46.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/62bd780808f302073c4cd053964f55803612ef29.png

5. The marker will disappear if the marker duration is 0, or if someone dig the displayed brick.
Also, when using the same item, the marker on the screen disappears and a new position appears.

 Mystery Item Mastery 
A new Mystery has been added.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/d5417dc48dec156254632d9285d058adf81071c3.png

The level of this mastery will increase when you craft mysterious potions and magic items.
When you craft Vaynell. This mastery will get exp.
Size Potion & Tool Damage Increase Potion, Emotion Change Potion is later moved to the Mystery Item mastery.

 Mailbox system 
The mailbox system has been added.
 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/adf14c8a3cd71d1550cda89a8a306e509880488a.png

 Required Item

notes.title: Update 2018-01-12
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone~
大家好~


Added
Archeology Mastery
Archeology Mastery has been added.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/267127fb2851fd5ed43cdde4fba5c3c206370a41.png

The following items have been added for Archeology Mastery.

1. Archeology Table 
You can make it on a Carpentry table.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/bf7add4f209ee8e58e0a66837e14b9c9fbefd97b.png

2. Fossil
You can get it from sedimentary rock at the Archeology Table.
3. Bone
It can be excavated from fossils.
You can make animal skeletal specimens.
4. Animal skeletal specimens
You can make skeletal specimens using the bones of animals that have been excavated from fossils.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/e0c2820aa9c9632d5dad3e7a9676eff24d8d19d4.png

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/0f8aa524fad3c12a1c84bdeab59d3cda8436762a.png

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/90087219535cebc2a3346d08ebf81920b1815f8a.png

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/3e72a9d343c490ebcd4710345ac6d1058aa26bbc.png

How to Study Archeology

1. Craft an Archeology Table and place it in the world.
2. Excavate fossils using sedimentary rocks at the Archeology Table.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/778760169d2b69483a1317fae62b734435c69e4d.png

3. Double-click on the fossils in the inventory to open the excavation pop-up window.
If a pop-up window is opened by double-clicking, the number is reduced even if it is not used.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/dfbbc3980bc811e6f6f77f85eb6e3693a3eabf1d.png

4. When the gauge enters the success zone by pressing the button, it will succeed and you will get one.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/58891fa2ac4c54275c20166e125059306fa86224.png

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/04c4e4c0f18cce1e414422777c5c69aba9774cf6.png

You will have 3 chances and When the button is pressed, the gauge is filled and the gauge stops if the button is not pressed.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/427df071b4aa4445bde3ef901a7910707cf79545.png

5. When you get fossils or bones, the experience of archeology mastery goes up.
6. It will be very difficult to find high-level fossils and bones.

Improved
Treasure box
The items in the treasure box have been improved.
The treasure box contains the following items.

Durable axe damage up potion, Durable shovel damage up potion, Durable sickle damage up potion, Durable pickax damage up potion, Bronze ingot, Iron ingot, Silver ingot, Gold ingot, diamond ore, Emotion of Joy, Emotion of Sadness, Small Spherical bombs, Small cube bomb, Magic Broom, heavy silver axe, heavy silver shovel, heavy silver sickle, heavy silver pickax.

Improved tool damage
Damage of axes and pickaxes has been improved.

Some brick HP fixes
HP of jungle tree and jungle tree roots, gold ore, and silver ore have been fixed.

Kitchen garden
When you share the area with other players, they can use your Kitchen garden in your personal area to farm. They can plant or harvest crops.

Photo frame
After dismantling the Photo frame, if you install it in the world again, the link will be maintained.

A private animal
In the resource map, the user can only release 10 animals.

Language 
Chinese is improved.
Thanks for reporting!!!”Greygod”


Thank You~!
And Happy New Year >___<

notes.title: Update 2017-09-13
notes.notes:
Hello everyone~

 Added

 Friends System
It does not apply on the local server,
You can open the friend window by clicking the button at the bottom right of the main screen.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/c5dfd57fd463b4e1f85272b82dfe1999baa345fd.png

When your friend connects, the message will be displayed on the chat window.
In the Friends window, you can see the following information about your friends:

Whether the friend is logged in,
the name of map that the friend is connected to, 
the last access time of the friend who logged off

Close friend registration
If you click on the heart icon in front of the character's name in the friend list, it will be registered as a close friend and will be displayed above the other friends in the friend list.
Click on the heart again to return to your normal friendship.

How to add friends
[olist]
Opens the Friends window.
In the Friends tab, type the name of the player you want to add and click the Add button next to it.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/61fc7d9a750fd5706d23ffb844d71fbbbf50b163.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/0180e2f065b7d3ba70a24ecb0ef9133e067daa34.png

Your request will be added to the recipient's ‘Received Request’ and you will become a friend if the player accepts it.
[/olist]

The maximum number of players that can make friends is 200.

Delete friend
If you click the button next to your friend's name in the Friends window, your friend will be deleted.

Received Request
The maximum number of requests we receive is 200. If you exceed 200, you will no longer be able to receive requests from other friends.

notes.title: Update 2017-08-02
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone~ > ㅅ <

 Added

Farming system
- Required Item

Kitchen Garden
You can craft it at the simple manufacturing table

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/275c44551194f659e0d6afdb9be2b34df239195a.png

Fertilizer/Calcium fertilize
You can craft it at Seedbed
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/feda5198fe7ec0504c77562bbc7bb322f3fdd649.png

Seed
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/50113d100ec58330e90fe2152a4278757aa55690.png
You can craft it at Seedbed or get it by detecting.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/7224314530ac91d104c31c0c8c191cc889758e7b.png


- How to farm
[olist]
Make kitchen garden and place in world.

Open the garden and put the seeds and begin cultivation.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/67f6a6f898d87b7cb92fd1e295fa6b5a59be17d3.png


Each crop has different time and conditions for growth.
Do not let the HP of crops become zero until the crop's growth time is over

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/702588d1d08c00ae164c83e1196e03dacd984df7.png

When the crops have been cultivated, you have to harvest within the specified time.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/d97a253b04faf46aa2875e87f7be15f31c02412f.png
[/olist]


    Success is determined by the HP status of the crop at the end of the crop's growth and the level of plant ecology mastery.
    The quantity of crops is influenced by the level of plant ecology mastery and the affection received by the players.


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/3c084d9bae591d9cedb89eac88137e8400c49192.png

- Crop`s Hp
The initial HP of the crop is influenced by the plant ecology mastery at the beginning of the cultivation.

- Reduction of crop HP
If the following conditions are not met, HP is reduced.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/702588d1d08c00ae164c83e1196e03dacd984df7.png

Nutrient
Crops consume nutrients in the kitchen garden every hour. 
Please be careful not to run out of nutrients.
You can put nutrients in the kitchen garden through the bottom left of the kitchen garden window. 

Nutrient fertilizer can be made from Seedbed.

Ph
Crops have a pH range that is suitable for growth. 
Do not let the pH fall out of range as the crop grows. 
You can make Calcium fertilize in the Seedbed. 
The Calcium fertilize will raise the Ph in the kitchen garden.

Temperature
Each crop has a temperature suitable for growth.

When seeds are placed in the kitchen garden, the date is displayed at the bottom of the kitchen garden window. 

If you plant on the first day that is checked, the temperature will not be a big problem as the crop grows.

Light
Each crop may like or hate light. 
If you are setting up a kitchen garden in the basement, please install a street light as well.

Water
Crops need water to grow. 
Please let the water touch the side of the garden. 
Water above or below the kitchen garden can not be consumed by crops.

- Recovering crop HP
If you select ‘Commune’ in the interaction menu of the kitchen garden, the affinity increases, and the HP of the crop also rises.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/10277cd6964f3665292dc6825900ad1ab880986e.png

You can also select ‘Commune’ in the interaction menu of other players' kitchen gardens and gain Plant Affinities mastery experience.

You can retry it in 5 minutes later

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/138600a3687a4f7daf5b3a4125785087c32a676f.png

You can see affection in the kitchen garden window.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/702588d1d08c00ae164c83e1196e03dacd984df7.png

- Plow up 
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/d97a253b04faf46aa2875e87f7be15f31c02412f.png

When the cultivation is finished, you can choose to Plow up before harvesting in your kitchen garden.

When you plow up, the nutrients that the crop has are absorbed into the kitchen garden.

This allows the garden to store more nutrients than its nutritional limit.
You can not gain experience if you plow up.


Crop
21 kinds of cultivable crops have been added.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/c6925e4f88de2f040bcdab9a221a20aa12c2472a.png

Ranking
‘Farmer’ have been added.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/dbe64f2ce368734d6f2d2eecf0b170cb201da0ba.png

 Improved

UI have been changed.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/057536f986a162492e82cd81d37f33c90bda20dd.png

 Bugfixed 

Ranking
Weekly rankings were not applied properly.
Thanks for reporting “四叔五茎”

Water tank
The amount of water in the water tank has decreased when it rained.

Detection Mastery
Detection Mastery's experience has been reduced.


Thank you~

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/50113d100ec58330e90fe2152a4278757aa55690.png
You can craft it at Seedbed or get it by detecting.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/7224314530ac91d104c31c0c8c191cc889758e7b.png


- How to farm
[olist]
Make kitchen garden and place in world.

Open the garden and put the seeds and begin cultivation.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/67f6a6f898d87b7cb92fd1e295fa6b5a59be17d3.png


Each crop has different time and conditions for growth.
Do not let the HP of crops become zero until the crop's growth time is over

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/702588d1d08c00ae164c83e1196e03dacd984df7.png

When the crops have been cultivated, you have to harvest within the specified time.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/d97a253b04faf46aa2875e87f7be15f31c02412f.png
[/olist]


    Success is determined by the HP status of the crop at the end of the crop's growth and the level of plant ecology mastery.
    The quantity of crops is influenced by the level of plant ecology mastery and the affection received by the players.


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/3c084d9bae591d9cedb89eac88137e8400c49192.png

- Crop`s Hp
The initial HP of the crop is influenced by the plant ecology mastery at the beginning of the cultivation.

- Reduction of crop HP
If the following conditions are not met, HP is reduced.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/702588d1d08c00ae164c83e1196e03dacd984df7.png

Nutrient
Crops consume nutrients in the kitchen garden every hour. 
Please be careful not to run out of nutrients.
You can put nutrients in the kitchen garden through the bottom left of the kitchen garden window. 

Nutrient fertilizer can be made from Seedbed.

Ph
Crops have a pH range that is suitable for growth. 
Do not let the pH fall out of range as the crop grows. 
You can make Calcium fertilize in the Seedbed. 
The Calcium fertilize will raise the Ph in the kitchen garden.

Temperature
Each crop has a temperature suitable for growth.

When seeds are placed in the kitchen garden, the date is displayed at the bottom of the kitchen garden window. 

If you plant on the first day that is checked, the temperature will not be a big problem as the crop grows.

Light
Each crop may like or hate light. 
If you are setting up a kitchen garden in the basement, please install a street light as well.

Water
Crops need water to grow. 
Please let the water touch the side of the garden. 
Water above or below the kitchen garden can not be consumed by crops.

- Recovering crop HP
If you select ‘Commune’ in the interaction menu of the kitchen garden, the affinity increases, and the HP of the crop also rises.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/10277cd6964f3665292dc6825900ad1ab880986e.png

You can also select ‘Commune’ in the interaction menu of other players' kitchen gardens and gain Plant Affinities mastery experience.

You can retry it in 5 minutes later

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/138600a3687a4f7daf5b3a4125785087c32a676f.png

You can see affection in the kitchen garden window.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/702588d1d08c00ae164c83e1196e03dacd984df7.png

- Plow up 
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/d97a253b04faf46aa2875e87f7be15f31c02412f.png

When the cultivation is finished, you can choose to Plow up before harvesting in your kitchen garden.

When you plow up, the nutrients that the crop has are absorbed into the kitchen garden.

This allows the garden to store more nutrients than its nutritional limit.
You can not gain experience if you plow up.


Crop
21 kinds of cultivable crops have been added.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/c6925e4f88de2f040bcdab9a221a20aa12c2472a.png

Ranking
‘Farmer’ have been added.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/dbe64f2ce368734d6f2d2eecf0b170cb201da0ba.png

 Improved

UI have been changed.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/057536f986a162492e82cd81d37f33c90bda20dd.png

 Bugfixed 

Ranking
Weekly rankings were not applied properly.
Thanks for reporting “四叔五茎”

Water tank
The amount of water in the water tank has decreased when it rained.

Detection Mastery
Detection Mastery's experience has been reduced.


Thank you~

notes.title: Update 2017-07-05
notes.notes:
Added

 Fruits & species of trees 

 - Name

Name change of tree roots, tree sprout, and tree seed
Item name -> Item name + (species : fruits name)
Ex.) fruit tree root -> fruit tree root (species : Apple)

 - Fruits

Apple (Lv.1)
Where to get : Fruits tree (species : Apple)
Harvest date : 7~10
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/d5957fb88f824c0dbf4d524e05fbb473280d01b6.png

Oriental Pear (Lv.3)
Where to get : Oak tree (species : Oriental Pear)
Harvest date : 8~10
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/5049196d8840d8b327d3c559da9518a21417a118.png

Banana (Lv.4)
Where to get : Jungle tree (species : Banana)
Harvest date : 5~6, 8~9
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/4cf8e84bab19651dc3e73d167c45c434ea91fff9.png

Date palm (Lv.5)
Where to get : acacia (species : Date palm)
Harvest date : 7~9
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/6f3291c4a9bc7de3acd60609d0d6742ae7a50766.png

You can get the fruit by cutting the leaves of the tree in the harvest season.

In the inventory, you can check harvest time with tree roots, sprout and seeds tooltips.
Please refer to the calendar on the side of the mini map for the harvest season

You can eat fruit right away.
When you eat fruit, you often get the seed of the fruit.
You can make that tree`s sprout as a seed in a germination pot.

 - species of trees

From the leaves, you can get the fruits of the climate that the tree mainly lives on.

The fruit that can be obtained becomes the species of tree.

fruit tree : Temperate climate fruits (Ex. Apple)
oak tree : Temperate, cold climate fruits (Ex. Oriental Pear)
jungle tree : Tropical climate fruit (Ex. Banana)
acacia : desert climate (Ex. Date palm)

Among the existing trees in the world, the above mentioned trees` name will be changed by this update.

More fruit will be added later. (Ex. fruit trees (species : peach))

 - Identification of species of trees

Trees placed in the world can not immediately identify the species.

In order to identify the species of trees, you can directly get the fruits, or you can see the species through the tooltip when the tree's root block or sprout block is in the inventory.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/bd6f520ab8d1db754f51b80392190329ffd1d92a.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/c70298c927a54fe06d1cd3571a0c73a3db4725bc.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/2b0ba9b52d66be6397db497c19145cdfcddff7b8.png

 Gathering Mastery 

When you get fruit from the leaves, the Gathering mastery gains experience.

You can get more kinds of fruits depending on the level of your picking mastery. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/9c50907a45fd1d2a8f7f3ba0ea9373d9477c5e80.png

 Calendar  

A calendar has been added on the side of the mini map

The numbers in the calendar are displayed from 1 to 12. If the day changes in the game, the calendar changes to the next day.

The calendar will be based on the harvesting time of the fruit and the sowing time of the farming to be updated.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/824d3cfe0543443664d63de318781b2be3fe4e31.png

 Temperature 
The temperature of the world is displayed.

 Rank is added. 
Fruit mania rankings have been added.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/71110127ec4f6daa32d2ad9c6e4912846dad4764.png

Improved

 UI is changed 

 - Option window

 - Character window

A mastery tab has been added.
The existing Mastery window has been deleted.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/3f28c32ef00988ef1ec4a71fbe00dcc6a697a4a3.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/59feab7ecb31cd697fe259a5baccad9096efc69c.png

 - Change the position of the buff icon 

The position of the buff icon has been moved to the upper left corner.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/a9ded80f9a7ac30292cd860a375b6a1343edd991.png

 Improved combat mode 
You can capture, tan and butcher without mode conversion in combat mode.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/886dacecc2adbc2442c06b3592da595151dba3dd.png

Bugfixed

 Font 
Fixed some unnecessary afterimages in Quick Slots and many parts.
Also, some font outlines did not appear correctly.

 Character window

You can fly in the air with birds

Take-off
When you ride a bird and press the space bar for a long time, Bird flies to the sky.

The skin color of animals
The color of the baby animal is affected by the color of the parent's skin. 
There is a small chance that mutants can be born with different skin colors.

- Animals

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/93964fb3f3fabfa723056f9c254b1f4473482a35.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/87f2e7866e5b4776d684b007898d958b83c9e6d1.png

Added a tabby rabbit, a tabby pig, a tabby bull, a white cat, and a zebra. 

They can be families if they are the same species. That is, a speckled rabbit and a white rabbit can also be a family.

Improved

- Satiety of food which can be installed

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/27f87e63d68c0c3f7dca0fcda6027cfa2bbf2fa8.png

If you move mouse pointer on it, You will see the satiety.
And we added satiety information in item tooltip

Thanks for suggestion! “초코파이”


- The values of pig are changed.

The survival probability of pig has increased.

Thanks for reporting! “초코파이”

- The time limit of personal area.

If you set your personal area and did not connect for 7 days, the area would be released. 

It has been improved.

When the area release time is less than 3 days, if the sharer connects, the time is reset to the 4th day.

For example, 
On the 6th day, when the sharer visits the map, the time is reset to the 4th day.
And On the 5th day, when the sharer visits the map, the time is reset to the 4th day.


- Damage up potion

Their cooldown time has been changed from 10 min to 7min, so when the buff is over, it will take 2 more minutes before you can use it again. (the cooldown time of these potions is 5min.) 

Thanks for suggestion! “초코파이”


- Animals

Currently, water and snow are recognized as food by animals, so animals can eat them.

So, there was a problem that the animals devour all water of the sea. To prevent this, If an animal eats only water, the animal will have an increased desire for food due to malnutrition. For that reason, animals can not live if they eat only water.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/b33ac4f8026f91e3fd8223c4a9e2165ccba3199b.png

Thanks for reporting! “Selpin”

-AI

Sometimes there were animals starving to death when the dirt block was just a one block high.

Now, they can eat dirt block up two blocks high.


Bugfix

- Local map UI
Fixed a problem that the name of the map did not appear correctly in the local map.

- wooden dressingtable
when you changed your hair style, The lights in the game were being applied incorrectly.


Thank you~
谢谢~

notes.title: Update 2017-03-06
notes.notes:
Hello everyone~ ːsteamhappyː yeah~
大家好~

Long time no see~
Recently, we moved our office and recruited new developer. 
So we did not have new update.
Sorry~

 Added

Disassembly Mastery

Now, you can disassemble items, but not all items can be disassembled.

when you opend the disassembly window, you can disassemble the activated item.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/6e3cb9001292bd38fdb56a4bb08415728a53263c.png

The maximum probability of success is 60 %.

But the lower durability of the item will cause the lower probability of success.

When the disassembly is successful, you can get the stuffs used in crafting stochastically.

(It does not always get all the stuffs, nor does it get the exact quantity that was used in crafting.)

If you disassemble food, you can get food garbage.

You can craft Disassembly table at the simple manufacturing table

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/8840044da44be28829e9dce20652c7db21413152.png


Climate & Weather

The climate system is applied first for the farming system and the weather system is modified accordingly.

Climate and weather have been applied to each map (but you can not see it now).

Temperatures and precipitation will be changed with the 12-day cycle as in the real world.

If the temperature is higher than 0, it will rain. If the temperature is lower than 0, it will snow.

When snow falls, snow accumulates and accumulated snow becomes water when the temperature is higher than zero.

The rain does not accumulate.

Animals can eat water and snow.


Leather Rope
Now, you can craft Leather Rope by Medium Leather, Heavy Leather, fur, Thick Leather.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/8734ef46153b339ead9faaf72a1ddf348687b416.png

Glue
You can craft Glue by Thick Leather.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/4b0dcd2df385ff4155d90bce06f4aaa4ad97da32.png

 Improved

The foods which can be installed

Its satiety value is increased

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/92f634abd20d077abd6660615e2f57365cb30990.png

Torch & wall mounted torch

You can craft Torch in basic craft window, it is Lv.1

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/4a4b18aaba36d10d3f48bd7f306fb84bb50891e6.png

You can craft wall mounted torch at the simple manufacturing table, it is Lv.3

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/f70cc0757816c39cf216dead77a7739bd9976cba.png

Fishing
Float can be shaken first, before fish eating the bait.

Treasure Box
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/784722a9824af17d03806c4df4147b98f3c57cd2.png
The model have been changed.

Client optimization and server optimization
The performances of client and Server have improved.


Thank You~
谢谢~

notes.title: Update 2017-01-20
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone~ >ㅅ<
大家好~

Added

Potion

A potion of random body size has been added. Its name is ‘Random scale nostrum’
You can craft it at the ‘alchemy table’
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/5777fd530ff87e5e960464d3c4cfd06f62b5bf81.png

This potion only changes the size of the body randomly. There is no other function.
This potion lasts for 10 minutes.

Water tank
The water tank is an object for farming.
This is added for testing before the farming system is added.
You can craft it at the ‘simple manufacturing table’

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/31ebd02c26ed56881211d8e85f6a5ccaf5705385.png

notes.title: Update 2016-12-01
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone~ Long Time No see :D


Added

Personal Trade System (between players)

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/d6f75b0f5f79bcfc5934cd4c52e97ec60ffa9c78.jpg

You can make a stall for personal trade. 

You can exchange items with other players by registering items you want and putting the items you have. Only the owner can use it.

Sellers can not require animals, 
and if the seller wants items with durability or freshness, buyers can only present items with 100% durability or freshness.

How to craft

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/8ca9564b281b807b9c1b5534bf834b03cb914d8b.png

How to use


Registering items


1.	Click the empty space.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/ef91217a45d81b8ab9618ba6b1714c1c271ab467.png

2.	Move the item you want to exchange from the inventory to the stall window.(management tab).
You can not control the quantity, so you must divide the quantity in the inventory first.

3.	When you click where the icon appears, the search window appears. Please type item name which you want, and select the item you want

4.	Control the quantity. But items that can not overlap can not control the quantity..

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/27f0c4a15ab5a3cbc297013adfe1658a0b503028.png

5.	Click the “Sell” button. And You will see what is registered in “List” tab.
 Fix condition
Click on the item you have already uploaded in management tab. And fix it

 End of transaction
Click on the item marked "Sold out" and click “Confirm” button

 Buy Items


http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/d0a3d44ea10e75dd08c1b59bfdeeb868124dafe0.png

[olist]
If you find what you want, click it, and you can see what seller wants.
If you want to trade, click “buy” button
[/olist]
If you Inventory is full, the item will move to gift box

Gift Box
Three tabs have been added.
It is divided into disassembly, trade, and gift and comes in each.
This feature does not work on the local server.

Crying animation.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713497/1e4f1c5c6cef03346554a874a1113667f9a65971.png
Type “/tt, /TT, /e6” in chatting space.


Improved
Object Removal Message.
It has been improved to express which objects will be removed when you remove an object.
Thank you for your suggestion ”노숙”!!

Animal protection in your territory.
Animals in your territory have been improved to avoid being hunted or killed by other animals.
Thank you for your suggestion. “쎌핀오빠”


Bug fix
Door open bug
There was a phenomenon that was reversed when the door was closed or open. We have Corrected the corresponding bug.
Thank you for your report.

Item book
When you chat, “back space” key also influenced the item book window

Players can repair the damaged item by using a repair kit. The success rate of repair is determined by the level difference of an item for repair and repair mastery level of the player. The amount of repairs will depend on the kind of repair kit. When you succeed, you can get EXP.

notes.title: Update 2016-06-06 And Preview Satiety System
notes.notes:
Today Patch Note. 


Imporved

- Hp GUI is changed.



HP GUI has been slightly changed.
Also, the GUI for satiety has been added in advance.

- Bug about NPC age.

An age of Animals became 1 days, when the age of the animals exceeded 2,500 days. 





Animals will survive even after 2500 days.
In addition, it is also solves the problem that animals which are older than 2500 days are changed a babies when riding them.


- Animals AI

Improved ability to find prey and hunt.
In addition, the animals will go to sleep if there is a bed nearby. In this case, they will have the advantage of the HP recovery and satiety.

- Improved server performance

Performance has been improved.

- Langague 
Chinese is improved 
Thanks!! "greygod" and "藤島ナルミ"

Resource map

Islet of Gold (every Monday ) (KST : 5pm , CET : 9 am , PST : 0 am )
Islet of Iron(every Wednesday) (KST : 5pm , CET : 9 am , PST : 0 am ) 
Islet of Marble (every Friday) (KST : 5pm , CET : 9 am , PST : 0 am) 

Preview satiety system
The satiety system is updated in the near future.
When satiety the system update, it will add the following features.

(1) Satiety
The satiety will be reduced as time goes on.
Satiety affects maximum HP. So it must adequately maintained by food intake.

(2) Food intake

It will be able to consume food.
However, if freshness is lower than 5, you must be careful because it may take food poisoning
Also, if you eat too much, you may not be able to move for a while.
Eating food in moderate amounts is important.
If you eat a breakfast in moderate amounts regularly in the game, you will get a buff like experience bonus.

(3) Food Freshness

Cooked foods have the freshness respectively.
The freshness of the food is deteriorated as time goes on, so you`d better cook the food in a timely manner.


Thank You and Have a Nice day~
